deposited_record.title: Observers are all you need
deposited_record.description: Observer Patch Holography (OPH) models observers as finite patches that retain records, compare overlap readbacks, and repair disagreement. On one finite regulator stage, a registered repair law, a declared clock-and-energy calibration and a refinement-uniform gap family give the four laws of thermodynamics, fluctuation relations and the Landauer bound as one machine-checked conditional theorem, and the mean entropy production of one repair step equals the relative entropy from its input state to the repaired image. Convergent repair produces protected public normal forms. On a declared signed-record branch of the twelve-port carrier, the normalized response metric has an exact rank-three quotient and a continuous Euclidean completion. Authenticated read-from provenance generates finite informational posets, and modular screen geometry supplies Lorentz-frame kinematics and a conditional Einstein construction. Under complete reversible port response and endogenous observer transport, the response has the local Standard Model gauge Lie type, and under a specified matrix-current and fermionic matter contract anomaly balance and tensor descent determine the charges and maximal faithful matter image (SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1))/Z6. A supplied charged-scalar/Maxwell action with positive mass squared and nonnegative quartic coupling has a nonlinear real zero-current sector whose trajectories converge at first order to smooth Neumann continuum solutions under uniform refinement, and its declared Laplace–Beltrami Hamiltonian has a unique self-adjoint closure. Declared screen-cell maps for the fine-structure constant have interval-certified fixed points at inverse couplings 136.994835... and 137.035660...; an executed closure with measured hadronic spectral data gives 136.3827548 on an interval that excludes the measured value; these endpoint comparisons are diagnostics. A frozen primitive-port branch fixes three linked dispersion coefficients and a degree-six icosahedral angular shape.
